title: [29.x]-Incident 51000001968459: Issue while creating any import purchase invoice
summary: Fixed inventory cost-loading for import purchase invoices with Nil-Rated GST and Non-Availment by ensuring Custom Duty is included in calculations even when GST amounts are zero.
key_points: Custom Duty now correctly included in Inventory and Direct Cost Applied entries for Nil-Rated GST imports
Cost-loading logic continues when Custom Duty exists instead of exiting prematurely
Logic restricted to Non-Availment lines only to prevent duplicate capitalization
Resolves issue where Custom Duty was previously omitted from cost calculations
quote: Updated the Non-Availment cost-loading logic to continue when Custom Duty exists and restricted it to Non-Availment lines
